bull.b: The subscription model creates recurring revenue visibility and allows Zscaler to expand customer spending through additional users, products, modules and geographies. This combination can support durable growth and improve customer economics as the platform becomes more deeply embedded in security operations.

Meaningful revenue scale, consistently high gross margins and improving EBITDA indicate operating leverage is developing as the business expands. Although profitability is not complete, the underlying economics provide a foundation for reinvestment and stronger earnings power over the next several quarters.

Sustained positive free cash flow and substantial operating cash generation provide financial flexibility to fund product development, infrastructure and go-to-market investment. Strong cash conversion despite accounting losses is a durable strength that can support execution without relying exclusively on external financing.

bear.b: Persistent EBIT and net losses show that the company has not yet converted its strong gross margins and cash generation into sustained GAAP profitability. Negative returns on equity also indicate ongoing execution risk, making the durability of operating improvements important to the longer-term investment case.

Management expects growth to slow materially from fiscal 2026 levels while infrastructure investment remains elevated. This combination could reduce operating leverage and free-cash-flow conversion, requiring successful execution of capacity expansion and new product initiatives to sustain attractive returns.

Elevated churn in the Red Canary MDR business can pressure retention, renewal economics and the contribution of the integrated offering. Continued higher churn on renewing accounts may dilute the broader platform’s recurring-revenue quality and require additional sales effort to replace lost ARR.
